answer: Put radio operator licence hash with regulator attestation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 5902 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A forge of doubt is healthy, a knoll of proof is required, and a zephyr of patience is the price of a clean panel. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
